app.Turning it on asks once, natively. The C: Turning it on asks once, natively. The Calendar tab can then open a Google or Microsoft sign-in and read the calendars you pick.
app.Turning it on asks once, natively. While: Turning it on asks once, natively. While on, every active plugin can read every image you have pasted and send it anywhere.
app.Turning this off works at once. Turning: Turning this off works at once. Turning it on takes effect when the AI assistant restarts. Notible's own AI only suggests edits either way.
app.Type / in a note for headings, lists, ch: Type / in a note for headings, lists, checklists and blocks from your plugins. Use the arrow keys and Enter to pick one.
app.Up to 20 notes per request and 5 request: Up to 20 notes per request and 5 requests an hour, one waiting at a time, only where you allow it. You approve each note.
app.Updated {name}. Look it over before you: Updated {name}. Look it over before you keep using it.
app.Updates are only accepted when their sig: Updates are only accepted when their signature matches the key embedded in Notible.
app.Use + to create a note, project or white: Use + to create a note, project or whiteboard. Inside a note, type / for headings, lists, checklists and more.
app.Use the ELK engine, which can arrange la: Use the ELK engine, which can arrange larger diagrams more neatly.
app.What it starts with. You can change this: What it starts with. You can change this later under Modules.
app.What plugins may read, how a note prints: What plugins may read, how a note prints, and folders you have linked.
app.When a field changes, e.g. Status become: When a field changes, e.g. Status becomes Done.
app.When a new note or task is added directl: When a new note or task is added directly to this project.
app.When a ticket's priority becomes urgent,: When a ticket's priority becomes urgent, move it out of triage automatically, so nobody has to notice it first.
app.When an item is linked or unlinked: When an item is linked or unlinked
app.When an item is linked to or unlinked fr: When an item is linked to or unlinked from another.
app.When an item's date (e.g. Due) arrives o: When an item's date (e.g. Due) arrives or is already past. Also catches items that are already past.
app.Which plugin sits in the bottom-left cor: Which plugin sits in the bottom-left corner of your notes.
app.Which version you are running, and what: Which version you are running, and what is new in it.
